node.title: Original raw weights through guarded anchors and pencil sections
node.statement: For a fixed original finite-label assignment and complete cores of size>=A, carry each pair's sum of original raw<=t weights unchanged through every affine section. Same-pair weight is at most n-A. Constant/nonconstant pencil caps are t+e Q^v and t(n-e)+e Q_h^v; good shared-carrier and determinant anchors extend by weighted incidence with explicit positive denominators, including all earlier anchor zeros. These are raw-mass bounds, not slope counts or arbitrary-hull realization claims.
